title: Human Resource Management in public sector organisations

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding concepts related to public organizations, human resources, and human resource management activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and compare the characteristics of human resource management in public organizations with other types of organizations.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding trends in public organizations and human resources
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and determine trends in public organizations and human resources based on fundamental theories.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding processes and contents of human resource management activities in public organizations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and master the procedures and contents of human resource management activities in public organizations such as planning, job analysis, recruitment, training, performance evaluation, compensation, etc.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and evaluating the current situation of human resource management activities in public organizations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and evaluate the actual situation and shortcomings of human resource management activities in public organizations.
Demonstrate communication and presentation skills effectively.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying knowledge and tools to analyze and evaluate human resource management activities in public organizations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply acquired knowledge and tools to analyze and evaluate the actual situation and shortcomings of human resource management activities in public organizations.
Be proactive in learning, research, and teamwork.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Proactively choosing topics, research methods, and presenting research results
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Proactively choose topics, research methods, and present research results.
